The '''M-350 landspeeder''',<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> or '''Nevarro speeder''',<ref name="Art of Mando">[[The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian (Season Two)|''The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season Two]]</ref> was a model of [[landspeeder]] manufactured by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]]. The [[Mythrol's speeder]] used by [[The Fledgling Mythrol|The Mythrol]] on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]] was one such [[speeder]]. The [[Mythrol]]'s M-350 landspeeder was destroyed by a [[Trexler 906 Armored Marauder]] during the [[Second skirmish on Nevarro|escape]] from a [[Nevarro Imperial base|Imperial base]] on Nevarro.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
